name: Cadmium
what_is: A heavy metal environmental contaminant that accumulates in the body.
why_botia: Accumulates in women at higher rates due to lower iron levels causing higher intestinal absorption.
can_1: Identify raw food ingredients with high cadmium accumulation risks.
can_2: Educate women on gender-specific absorption kinetics of cadmium.
cannot_1: Measure the actual concentration in the finished product through label OCR.
cannot_2: Confirm compliance with European maximum levels without chemical analysis.

sources.label: EFSA Metals as Contaminants in Food
Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 on contaminants in food
